issues.what: Compiler unions every keyframe that covers a year, and a Cliopatria shape keeps its shapes.csv years although the dossier text says 'valid X-Y'; a later, smaller keyframe never replaces it. Found by resolving the overlapping keyframes of all dossiers alive in the window (earlier shape holds cells the later one lacks) and by scanning correction texts for stated validity. 34 validity-only overrides (one is a second span for taifa-of-seville) (shape and correction copied unchanged from the dossiers).

Almoravid Saharan wing (Tiris Zemmour, Adrar, Tindouf, 4,003 cells) put back by the compiler from 1087 to 1093 although the dossier's 1087 and 1090 keyframes cut it; the 1085 shape (text 'valid 1085-1086') was still unioned. Snaps of 4,006 (1087) and 4,005 (1094) gone.

Almoravid takes Cordoba, Seville, Almeria and Murcia at the end of 1090 in one keyframe, a year or two before the page dates them (Granada Sept 1090; Cordoba early 1091; Seville Sept 1091; Almeria late 1091; Murcia late 1091 or Jan 1092). Split into three dated keyframes.

Sultanate of Rum 1094 shape kept to 1098 after Nicaea (19 June 1097) and the western cities returned to Byzantium; 842 cells too many in 1097-98. Rum/Byzantine conflict fell from 768 to 26 cell-years.
Chola shape with Sri Lanka kept to 1093; Vijayabahu drove the Cholas out in 1070 (432 cells).
Western Xia: the shape for 1036-39 (Ganzhou and Guiyi annexed by 1036) was drawn from 1034 and unioned with the 1032 keyframe.

Oghuz take the steppe east of the Dnieper from the Pechenegs in 1043 (Pecheneg ledger) but their 1046-55 keyframe is the unchanged Aral shape, so 963 cells went to nobody in 1046-54. Keyframe widened; a ruling gives the Cumans the steppe in 1055 so the 1055 state is as before.

Size rule gave the western lands to the smaller Leon in 1033-34 although Sancho III took Zamora (1033) and Leon (1034); ruling for Pamplona, and an event returning the land to Leon in October 1035 (the Pamplona ledger's own 1035 loss moved nothing because the same year's split had already released the cells).

County of Portugal (from 1096) is drawn independent; Henry held it under Alfonso VI (vassal tint missing); 326 cell-years of Portugal/Castile size-rule conflict that Portugal rightly won.

Biggest size-rule conflicts checked (Nasrids of Sistan, Kerait/Liao, Marwanids/Byzantium, Ziyarids, Khwarezmids/Kimek-Kipchak, Buyids/Ghaznavids Kerman, Hammadid/Maghrawa, Croatia/Hungary, Chola/Western Chalukya): the smaller state's win is plausible; Kashmir/Lohara/Utpala conflicts are same_state rows.

problems: compiler: do_keyframe unions every keyframe with from <= y <= to, and keyframes() takes from/to of a Cliopatria shape from shapes.csv (only a new keyframe may carry its own years). Dossiers write 'valid X-Y' or 'years X-Y only' in the correction text of Cliopatria shapes, which is not read. Effects in this window: 4,003 Almoravid Saharan cells back 1087-1093, Ghaznavid Persia from 1028, Sulayhid Yemen 1056-61, Poland, Rum, Zirid, Chola. Fixed here with 34 validity-only keyframe_overrides; every other window probably has the same fault (scan: dossiers whose keyframe ranges overlap, or whose text range differs from shapes.csv). A compiler rule 'a later keyframe supersedes an earlier one from its start year' or reading the text range would fix all windows at once.
